name: Military Conflict: Vietnam
author: Skila@no-email.com
description: Military Conflict: Vietnam dedicated server for Pelican using the native Linux 64-bit Source server.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Military Conflict: Vietnam Dedicated Server Steam App ID.

variables.name: Server Hostname
variables.description: The name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password required to join the server. Leave empty for no password.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Password used for Source RCON remote administration.

variables.name: Default Map
variables.description: Map loaded when the server starts.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Automatically check for Steam updates when the container starts.

install.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Military Conflict: Vietnam - SteamCMD Linux installation
# Server Files: /mnt/server

if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install Military Conflict: Vietnam Dedicated Server
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} validate +quit

## set up Steam client libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## create the config Pelican will manage
mkdir -p /mnt/server/vietnam/cfg
cat > /mnt/server/vietnam/cfg/server.cfg <<'EOF'
hostname "Military Conflict Vietnam Server";
sv_password "";
rcon_password "change-me-rcon";
EOF

## make Linux launchers executable
chmod +x /mnt/server/srcds_run_x64 /mnt/server/srcds_linux64 2>/dev/null || true

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"
